_note: Where you can be. The name of the place you're in is the first line of the middle section's left side (Roy, October 11: "location / activity / (mood)"). Changing places takes no time and is never told (Roy, October 11, 228). **Only home is shown (Roy, Oct 15, 381):** "right now the only setting where location is shown as home. other places we should just get the activity". A place with `shown: true` has its name on the left; any other leaves the line blank and the activity shows alone. The names stay here for the diary and the checks. `open` is a place's hours; nothing happens there while it's closed. `person` is when PERSON is there: Roy's writing has them working at the library; the days and hours are provisional, each end up to `vary` minutes earlier or later, the same for a given day however often it's asked.
_names: PROVISIONAL WORDS. Roy asked for a location line and hasn't supplied the names. These are Claude's, kept to the plainest everyday name for each place, and each one is built from a word already in his writing ("returning home", "work at store", "visit library", "the food distro", "you wander into the woods"); "grocery store" is from "buy groceries". They wait for his approval or rewording, except "grocery store", which he wrote himself on October 12 (268). An empty name shows nothing.
